messages:
sara_support: FYI — AcmeCorp is hitting intermittent timeouts followed by 5xx after we moved them to a new model variant during a canary. They report a ~10–15s hang, then a 502 or 504. Their client (sdk-js v1.4.2, maxRetries=3) retried and ended up being billed for duplicate embed calls. Repro steps + logs below.

mike_oncall: Ack, I'll pick this up. Do we have the exact request_ids and model names?

sara_support: Provided by customer: request_ids: [r-20240315-ACME-111, r-20240315-ACME-112], they were switched from redwood-small-v2 -> redwood-small-quant (canary batch). SDK traces: see snippet.

alan_eng: Can you paste the gateway/edge logs around those request_ids? Want to check connection resets / backend cold start. Also which region?

sara_support: logs (edge):

```
[edge] 2024-03-15T18:12:03Z request_id=r-20240315-ACME-111 client_ip=1.2.3.4 route=/v1/embeddings model=redwood-small-quant status=upstream_pending
[edge] 2024-03-15T18:12:13Z request_id=r-20240315-ACME-111 status=504 upstream_timeout backend=pool-prod-12 reason="no-response"
[edge] 2024-03-15T18:12:13Z request_id=r-20240315-ACME-111 retry=1 forwarded=true
[edge] 2024-03-15T18:12:28Z request_id=r-20240315-ACME-111 status=200 downstream_latency=1200ms tokens=5

[edge] 2024-03-15T18:12:04Z request_id=r-20240315-ACME-112 client_ip=1.2.3.4 route=/v1/embeddings model=redwood-small-quant status=upstream_pending
[edge] 2024-03-15T18:12:14Z request_id=r-20240315-ACME-112 status=502 upstream_reset backend=pool-prod-9 reason="connection-reset"

```

alan_eng: Hmm — both show a ~10s wait then failure. One later succeeded after a retry, which aligns with the SDK retry behavior. Looks like cold-starts on the canary pool + transient proxy resets.

mike_oncall: Did the canary rollout overlap with autoscaler events? deploy-bot, any recent rollout events timestamped before 18:12?

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started 2024-03-15T18:10:45Z target=redwood-small-quant subset=10% region=us-west2
deploy-bot: Autoscaler scaled pool-prod-9 up at 2024-03-15T18:11:50Z (k8s event node-provision).

alan_eng: Autoscaler + new model variant -> plausible cold cache + kvcache miss causing first requests to hit slow path. The proxy connection resets could be from backend pod evictions while warmup happening.

jess_prod: Customer-facing update needed. Sara, can you confirm whether the customer sees persistent errors or just a short window? Also they flagged duplicate billing for embeddings — Kevin, can billing help?

sara_support: Customer says errors were concentrated 18:10–18:30 window and then recovered. They reported 2 embedding charges for what they thought was a single call due to the SDK retries. I collected their billing request_ids.

kevin_billing: We can issue a credit for duplicate embed charges. We'll need the request_ids + customer account id (they provided acct_acme_999). I'll flag finance for manual credit. Also will add guardrail notes for SDK-visible retries causing apparent double-billing.

alan_eng: Short-term mitigation: route canary traffic through a warm pool when canary flip occurs, and increase backend keepalive and reduce immediate eviction during autoscale spikes. Also add server-side circuit-breaker so we don't forward to pods that are still starting.

mike_oncall: For support patch: advise customer to bump SDK to v1.5.0 (has safer retry jitter) or set maxRetries=1 while we investigate. Provide them with a temporary fallback route to redwood-small-v2 if they need immediate reliability.

sara_support: Sent customer note: "We're seeing a short warm-up window during the canary. To stop duplicate charges, set maxRetries=1 or temporarily pin to redwood-small-v2. We're issuing a billing credit for the duplicate embed calls." They asked for an ETA on permanent fix.

alan_eng: I'll open an internal task: add warm-pool routing for canary flips + backend circuit-breaker on route-layer. Plan: PR to routing-service to add pod readiness gating (avoid forwarding until readiness AND kvcache primed). ETA: 3 business days for PR + canary.

jess_prod: I'll create a post-incident follow-up and a short KB for support playbook: "If customer reports 5xx during variant rollout: suggest temporary pin, lower retries, and inform billing to credit duplicates."

kevin_billing: Billing credit created under ticket BC-98765. Will notify when applied.

mike_oncall: Action items: Alan to PR circuit-breaker, EngInfra to change autoscale grace, Support to send final customer note once credit applied.

sara_support: Thanks — I'll keep the thread updated. Customer confirmed they accepted the temporary fallback and are fine with the credit.

alan_eng: One more datapoint — capture sample payload size and kvcache hit ratio for that window. If heavy prefix variance, we'll need prewarming hooks for embeddings.

sara_support: Uploaded payloads + request ids to the internal ticket. Closing loop once credit is applied and PR merges. :white_check_mark:
